title: Buy it! You’ll love it! Your feet and back will thank you!
text: Buy it! You’ll love it! Your feet and back will thank you!. I LOVE my Topo mini! One of the best purchases I have ever made! I work in Television/ Film and we stand on concrete sound stages anywhere from 10-15 hours a day. Topo mini is amazing! It is so cushy and comfortable. So many ridges and places to work out and massage your feet and calves! I love it! I sent the link to about 5 people at work the day I got it! There was a line to try it out! Just buy it! You won’t be sorry!

product_metadata.title: Topo Mini by Ergodriven | The Smaller Not-Flat Standing Desk Anti-Fatigue Mat with Calculated Terrain (Denim Blue)
features: THE BEST STANDING DESK MATS: Topo is the first anti-fatigue mat designed specifically for standing desks. Topo Mini boasts the same premium comfort mat material and similar next-generation terrain features in a smaller footprint.

SIT LESS AND STAND BETTER: Spend more time out of your chair and move more while you stand, with Topo Mini’s meticulously designed ergonomic topography. Our infinite possible micro and macro movements provide a plethora of new and dynamic positions.
IMPROVE YOUR MOVEMENT WITHOUT EVEN THINKING: Topo Mini’s cushioned terrain drives subconscious movement, stretching, and massage - unlike distracting balance boards and treadmills.

MAKE THE MOVE TO STANDING EASIER: You can reposition Topo Mini with just one foot, unlike normal anti-fatigue mats designed for kitchens. Grab Topo Mini’s back ramp with your heel or toe to pull the mat out from under your desk. Then just push forward to slide it back.

GET THE TRUE BENEFIT OF STANDING: Topo Mini will leave you feeling energized and productive, because the more you move, the better you feel. You’ll buy in confidence thanks to Topo Mini’s 7-year manufacturer’s warranty and 100% full-refund satisfaction guarantee.
